# Proof-Carrying Authority (PCA)

> PCA is an execution-authentication framework for autonomous agents. It adds authF ("is this specific
> action a faithful, uncompromised execution of an authority the principal actually conferred?") to the
> classic authN (who are you?) and authZ (what may you do?). Instead of a bearer token, an agent presents
> a Proof-Carrying Action (PCActn) with every action, and the resource server verifies a proof offline.

## What a PCActn is

- A single strict-canonical-JSON object, wire version 2: bytewise-sorted keys, no insignificant
  whitespace, a closed top-level field set, canonical unpadded base64url byte fields, bounded numbers and
  nesting.
- It carries: the action, a reference to the principal's Root Intent Grant, an attenuable capability
  chain rooting in that grant, a Merkle plan-inclusion proof, freshness binding (audience + issued-at/
  expiry), a monotonic counter, and a leaf signature over the canonical body. Optional signed fields add
  attestation, provenance/taint, threshold shares, crypto-agility (alg / post-quantum keys), and more.

## Offline verification (the stable core)

A resource server verifies a PCActn statelessly with eight checks, in this fixed normative order, each
fail-closed; the action is allowed only if none reports failure:

1. wire — strict canonical form, closed field set (TERMINAL: a failure stops all further checks)
2. version — ver == 2
3. audience — signed `aud` equals this resource server's own id
4. validity — issued-at/expiry window and clock skew (bounded lifetime)
5. chain (cap_chain) — capability chain verifies and only attenuates
6. plan_inclusion — the action is a committed node of the authorized plan (Merkle proof)
7. leaf_signature — the capability-chain leaf holder signed the canonical body
8. counter — monotonic anti-replay counter present and well-formed

Stronger rungs (attestation, taint gate, threshold co-signing, revocation, zero-knowledge, bonds) are
verifier HOOKS on top of this core. Each reports "not-enforced" unless configured, and not-enforced is
NOT pass: a relying party that needs a rung must inspect per-check results and refuse what it needed.

## Credential model

Authority is an attenuable capability chain rooted in a principal-signed Root Intent Grant. Holders may
narrow (add caveats) but never widen; each delegation hop is signed and bound to its holder, so a leaked
capability is inert.

## Signature suites

- ed25519 (default)
- ml-dsa-65 (FIPS-204, post-quantum)
- hybrid-ed25519-ml-dsa-65 (classical + post-quantum)

The suite id and post-quantum public key are part of the signed body, so a downgrade or key swap
invalidates the action.

## Native verifiers (all pass the same conformance corpus)

TypeScript (reference), Go, Python, Ruby, PHP, .NET, Swift, Java, Rust, Kotlin — all ten implement the
ed25519, ml-dsa-65, and hybrid-ed25519-ml-dsa-65 suites and pass the full conformance corpus, including
the post-quantum vectors. (Java and Kotlin use BouncyCastle >= 1.80; Rust uses the fips204 crate.)

## Conformance & playground

- conformance/ — golden + adversarial PCActns with expected verdicts and per-check results, plus
  canonical-JSON, base64url, and Merkle primitive vectors. Independent implementations self-certify.
- playground/ — mint a grant, commit a plan, forge/verify PCActns, watch the trust budget drain.

## Maturity

The PCActn wire format (v2) and the eight-check offline core are stable and conformance-covered across all
ten verifiers (every one post-quantum-capable). The higher rungs are implemented and tested. A few carry
a remaining production requirement: a live TEE/hardware attestation needs real SEV-SNP/TDX silicon (the
verifier is tested against real-crypto mock reports); unforgeable FROST guardian custody needs the shares
in separate trust domains / HSMs with a network signing protocol (the reference runs in-process); the
malicious-secure MPC's offline triple generation is trusted-dealer today (a no-dealer OT/HE phase is
designed); and the zero-knowledge circuit proves a decision subset (plan-membership + risk ≤ budget).
None are vaporware; all rungs are additive, fail-closed, and backward-compatible.
